title: Butterfly wing patterns make motion hard to read
title_zh: 蝴蝶翅膀花纹使运动难以辨认
abstract: Movement can expose camouflaged prey, yet whether colour patterns help moving prey to avoid capture is a long-standing puzzle. Butterfly wings might offer an answer.
abstract_zh: 运动可能暴露伪装的猎物，但彩色花纹是否有助于移动的猎物避免被捕获，是一个长期的谜题。蝴蝶翅膀或许能提供答案。
snippet: Movement can expose camouflaged prey, yet whether colour patterns help moving prey to avoid capture is a long-standing puzzle. Butterfly wings might offer an answer.
